usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, official exchange rate
usdRate.note: AMD 360.14 per USD; World Bank 2025 average 387.01.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia (home page, 12-month inflation)
inflation_cpi.note: 12-month CPI inflation 4.3% in September 2026 (4.4% in August, Trading Economics).

inflation_projection.sourceName: CBA 3% inflation target; CPI 4.3% (Sep 2026); IMF WEO 4.6% (2026), 3.0% from 2029
inflation_projection.note: The 3% target is credible over time but inflation is above it now, so 3.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, policy (refinancing) rate
policy_rate.note: Raised by 25 bp to 6.75% on 15 September 2026 (date from Trading Economics); next decision 3 November 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: The CBA deposit rate series covers term deposits only; no typical rate on ordinary savings/demand accounts was found.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, interest rates on attracted deposits (61-90 days, AMD)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Weighted average rate on new AMD deposits of 61-90 days in September 2026 (file 11_Deposit_rates_eng.xlsx); 91-180 days 7.71%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, interest rates on attracted deposits (181 days-1 year, AMD)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Weighted average rate on new AMD deposits of 181 days to 1 year in September 2026; over 1 year 9.43%. USD deposits pay about 3.3%.

dps_rate.note: No published rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, average interest rate on attracted AMD deposits (up to 1 year and more)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: September 2026 weighted average for new AMD deposits; World Bank FR.INR.DPST 8.03% (2025).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Saving coupon bonds (3 months to 25 years, tax-exempt) are sold only to individuals through Treasury Direct, but the sales system listed no bonds on sale and no current coupon rate was published; the 5-year government yield curve point was 8.15% on 30 Oct 2026.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, treasury bill yield curve (90 days, ACT/360)
tbill_91d_rate.note: From YC_ENG.xlsx; the 364-day bill sold at a 6.75% weighted average in September 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, treasury bond yield curve (5-year yield to maturity)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Nelson-Siegel curve built from government bond quotes; spot 8.23%.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Armenia, treasury bond yield curve (10-year yield to maturity)

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Armenia, taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest, if not exempt, is taxed at 20% from 1 January 2023, withheld by the bank.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Ministry of Finance of Armenia, Treasury Direct (saving bonds)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Income from government securities bought through Treasury Direct, including saving bonds, is exempt from any taxation.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: AMD 16,000,000 for dram-only deposits; AMD 7,000,000 for foreign-currency-only deposits.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate could be read from CBA sources.

equity_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (AMD per USD 387 in 2025); CBA rate 360.14 on 30 Oct 2026
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund in dram terms if shares are weak and the dram keeps appreciating; the local exchange is too small for a diversified fund.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 1-year government bond 7.21% (tax-free) and 1-year deposit 8.64% less 20% tax = 6.9%; global equity in AMD
equity_return_base.note: Armenia has no meaningful local equity market, so the base case is a global index in dram terms, about 2 points over the tax-free 1-year government yield and within the 4-point cap.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run record plus dram depreciation
equity_return_high.note: High case with strong global shares and a weaker dram.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (AMD per USD 387 in 2025, 360 in Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a stronger dram.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (AMD per USD 387 in 2025, 360 in Oct 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus about 1% a year of dram weakness over the long run.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (AMD per USD 387 in 2025, 360 in Oct 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker dram.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: rolling short bills or deposits after tax, allowing for policy rate cuts.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 1-year deposit 8.64% less 20% tax = 6.9%; 1-year government yield 7.21% tax-free
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-year deposits after tax or 1-year government securities.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 5-year government bonds held to maturity.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found; the life insurance market in Armenia is very small.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates by age were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age band were found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No Armenian medical price index was read, so we plan with the 3.5% projection plus one point; most health costs are paid out of pocket.

goal_inflation_education.note: No Armenian education price index was read, so we plan with the 3.5% projection plus one point for fees.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 21.7 (2025, World Bank), 31.0 (2040) and 53.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/armenia/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: Pension age 63 for men and women; secondary source because the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs pension pages render without text.

retirement_age_government.note: The age limit for civil servants could not be confirmed from an official or secondary source.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: rolling short government bills if rates fall.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax 1-year deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of government bonds up to 5 years.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: 1-year government yield 7.21%; global equity low case 5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag and the dram strengthens.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: 5-year government yield 8.15%; global equity base 9% in AMD
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half global equity at 9% and half dram government bonds at about 7%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: 10-year government yield 8.70%; global equity high case 12%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Armenia pays an old-age social pension to people without enough insurance record, but its current amount could not be read on the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs site (pages render without text).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The eligibility age of the old-age social pension could not be confirmed from an official source (Wikipedia says 63, which matches the labour pension age).

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees was found in the Armenian Labour Code; severance applies only to dismissal.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Wikipedia, Pensions in Armenia; Wikipedia, Retirement age
public_pension_scheme.note: State labour pension from 63 plus a mandatory funded pension for those born after 1973 (5% of pay, or 10% minus AMD 25,000 above AMD 500,000, with state co-financing; administered via cda.am). No automatic inflation indexation rule was found; amounts change by government decision. Secondary source.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold only to individuals through Treasury Direct, 3 months to 25 years, tax-exempt; none were on sale when checked.

tbill_91d.note: Individuals can buy through Treasury Direct; income tax-exempt.

tbond_5y.note: Up to 10% of each issue is offered through Treasury Direct.

equity_fund.note: There is no liquid local stock market; diversified equity exposure is mainly through pension funds or foreign funds.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold was found.

pensionScheme.name: Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs – pensions
pensionScheme.note: Funded pension accounts: Central Depository of Armenia (cda.am).

oldAgeAllowance.name: Old-age social pension (Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health – state-guaranteed basic benefits package

statistics.name: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia (Armstat)
